programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska Martyna Wojciechowska visits Lebanon to meet Ghada.In Syria she was involved in teaching.She hid from her husband and in-laws that she was studying, because in this country women's independence is not welcome.After the outbreak of the war, she became a social activist for representatives of her gender and children.He has been living in Lebanon for four years.He is already building a second school for young Syrians there.Her students had to leave their homeland before the war.Ghada founded the Damma organization and helps women find their way in new realities.Most of them support their families on their own.They also need integration and joint action.The heroine of the episode teaches Syrian women independence and gives them hope for a better tomorrow.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: On August 4, 2020, a powerful explosion occurred in the capital of Lebanon, Beirut.Almost 200 people died, thousands were injured, and 300,000 city residents lost their homes.The tragedy was caused by the explosion of 2,750 tons of domestic saltpeter, previously confiscated and stored in the port.A small Middle Eastern country - which has been struggling for years with the economic crisis, corruption, poverty and unemployment, and the problem of Syrian refugees - was unable to cope with the enormity of the destruction left after the explosion.The whole world supported him, but many months passed before the city was rebuilt.One of the people who supported the injured was volunteer Zena Chahine.She is the first woman in the ranks of the Lebanese volunteer fire brigade.Following her example, dozens of other brave ladies entered the service.To this day, ignoring the danger, he does everything to rebuild his beloved city.

programme.title: Africa Express
programme.desc: For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship Participants go to Vibanda Village, where an unusual challenge awaits them: "7 Monsters", i.e. a roulette of flavors.Each pair spins the wheel three times and must eat the selected local dishes until the end.Then the competition moves to the Kenya Railway Museum, where you have to arrange ten photos from different stages of the race.Another obstacle is field assignments in Nairobi.Participants go to designated places where they solve numerical puzzles that require perceptiveness and reflexes.In the finale, the couples travel through various corners of the city, visiting, among others:a hairdressing salon or a giraffe shelter.Only the fastest and most persistent have a chance to reach the finish line, located on the roof of the Kenya International Convention Center.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal Brodnicki likes to explore the world through his sense of taste.He loves to prepare various dishes at street stalls, in African villages or on the beach. However, during his culinary journeys it was not always easy for him.Sometimes elephants stole his ingredients.Of course, Pascal couldn't deny himself the pleasure of tasting local delicacies.In Delhi, he stopped for a long time at a paratha stand, in a Zanzibar village he ate rice with coconut, and in Namibia he tried a zebra steak."Taste the world with Pascal" is not only about cooking.The host visited an elephant orphanage in Sri Lanka, fed cheetahs in Africa and climbed a coconut tree.In Bombay he became a teacher and taught Polish to children, and on the coast of Zanzibar he hunted octopus.Everywhere his passion and positive energy attracted crowds of onlookers This time Pascal went to Namibia, famous for its cow breeding and delicious beef.The chef grills his favorite steaks here and, as usual, he will do it in an unusual place.This time on the farm where they are kept.tamed cheetahs.After meeting the big cats, Pascal sets off north of the country, to Opuwo, where he goes to a supermarket.Here he meets half-naked women from the Himba tribe who are shopping.He also visits the market where he buys a gift for the Herrero tribe - a goat.His gesture wins great acclaim and Pascal is welcomed into the village with an amazing dance.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is visiting Japan.He decides to meet the doll woman.So she goes to Tokyo, where she meets a man who is in love with Megumi.Practical Japanese people increasingly replace true love in this way.They even marry artificial women.According to estimates, there are as many as twenty thousand men in the Land of the Rising Sun who have such a doll.Their size, weight and appearance reflect humans.The traveler is looking for answers to the questions whether it is possible to fall in love with a doll and whether it is an image of the future.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: This time, Martyna Wojciechowska moves not only in space, but also in time.He goes to a place that is only thirty kilometers from Santa Cruz - one of the largest, most populated cities in Bolivia.The traveler visits Mennonites living in harsh and wild rural communities.They consciously reject electricity and modern technology.They devote themselves to religion, farming and animal husbandry.They don't do any sports, they don't have access to TV or phones because all of this is prohibited.Their education ends with basic knowledge of arithmetic and the study of the Bible.Viewers will see how Martyna Wojciechowska finds herself in this extraordinary world.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits an extraordinary beauty salon located in Lahore, Pakistan.His services are used by women who have suffered acid burns in the past.Dousing and arson attacks affect up to several thousand women every year.A bottle of acid does not cost even a zloty, the substance is easily available, and the attack lasts a few seconds.The traveler talks to Musarrat Misbah, who has already helped over five hundred injured women.It provides victims with proper medical care, reconstructive surgery, psychological care and employment.He gives them jobs in his salon.Viewers will see what the life of the so-calledfaceless women.
